name: Classical Myth in Art
homeDescription: A study guide to Greek and Roman myth in art: the gods and heroes through 170 paintings, sculptures, and vases, each with the story it shows and key terms.
ldDescription: The stories of the Greek and Roman gods and heroes, told through paintings, sculpture, and vases.
sourcesDescription: The textbook, articles on myth in art, and public-domain translations behind {name}.
creditsIntro: All images come from Wikimedia Commons and are marked public domain or CC0 there. Many are museum open-access files (Metropolitan Museum of Art, National Gallery of Art, Rijksmuseum); the rest are photographs or reproductions their authors released into the public domain. Follow each link for the file’s full record.
creditsDescription: Sources and licenses for the {count} public-domain and CC0 images in {name}, all from Wikimedia Commons.
strip: The material follows a college survey of classical mythology, rewritten for general readers.
